verdict.rationale: Inngest's execution model is inherently headless (functions run as backend services), and there is concrete evidence of a scriptable CLI (verified runtime install via npx), a public REST API for programmatic control, self-hosting/deploy-to-own-infra options, and a Jest-compatible testing framework built for automated test suites. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions) and independent hands-on confirmation of running fully headlessly in CI.
